tool.name: nf-core flye
tool.description: De novo assembler for single molecule sequencing reads
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ flye \\ $mode \\ $reads \\ --out-dir . \\ --threads \\ $task.cpus \\ $args
gzip -c assembly.fasta > ${prefix}.assembly.fasta.gz gzip -c assembly_graph.gfa > ${prefix}.assembly_graph.gfa.gz gzip -c assembly_graph.gv > ${prefix}.assembly_graph.gv.gz mv assembly_info.txt ${prefix}.assembly_info.txt mv flye.log ${prefix}.flye.log mv params.json ${prefix}.params.json
